description: This file contains JNI (Java Native Interface) code for image processing in the PyTorch Android torchvision project. It defines a native method for cropping and normalizing YUV420 images into a float buffer, and registers this method with the JVM.

methods.name: JNI_OnLoad
methods.description: JNI entry point called when the native library is loaded; registers the native method with the JVM.

methods.name: imageYUV420CenterCropToFloatBuffer
methods.description: Performs center cropping, rotation, and normalization of YUV420 image data into a float buffer for tensor input.
